description: A default value that refers to a variable is an error
notes: The README says the type syntax is processed statically, and TypeConstraintWithDefaults takes only the expression and returns default values as values (Defaults.DefaultValues), so a default value has no variables or functions: a variable is an error even when the application defines it. hashicorp/hcl evaluates each one with Value(nil) (getType in ext/typeexpr/get_type.go).
